copy.npr_heading: AEG 10kg Front Load Washing Machine 9000 Series – White
copy.npr_short_copy: Full laundry baskets can build up quickly in busy homes. This 10kg front load washing machine handles larger loads, while AutoDose, PowerCare and PreciseWash help manage detergent, cleaning settings and energy use. Steam, Hygiene and Woolmark Green features give everyday loads more care.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Busy households can quickly fill a washing machine with clothes, towels and bedding. This 10kg front load washing machine gives larger families and frequent washers room for bigger loads, while its 5-star energy and 4.5-star WELS ratings support considered everyday washing.

AutoDose dispenses detergent for each load, so you won't need to measure it before every wash. PowerCare premixes detergent, helping it work through the wash, while PreciseWash adjusts settings and energy use according to load weight. The 1600rpm variable-speed spin can help remove more water before clothes reach the line or dryer.

Steam and Hygiene options give you more ways to choose a wash for different household loads. Delicate and Wool programmes help you select gentler care for suitable fabrics, while the stainless-steel CareDrum supports regular washing. An LCD with electronic rotary and touchscreen controls shows cycle progress, load information and indicators such as Add Clothes, Anti-crease and Finish In.

AEGConnected lets you interact with and monitor this washer from a mobile device when connected. The cold-water connection uses 86L per wash, and the 52dBA noise level supports washing while other household activities continue. Finished in White, this 79kg washer measures 597mm wide, 847mm high and 660mm deep, with a 5-year warranty for busy laundry rooms handling full baskets.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Undermount Rangehood 1200mm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking smells and steam can linger after dinner. This ducted rangehood gives you five speed levels, soft-touch controls and LED lighting, while dishwasher-safe mesh filters make regular cleaning easier in a concealed, matte black design.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Steam, smoke and cooking smells can quickly fill a busy kitchen, especially when several burners are in use. This 1200mm ducted undermount rangehood fits discreetly into cabinetry, helping keep the cooking area clearer while its matte black finish suits modern kitchens. It’s made for home cooks who want extraction without a prominent canopy.

The Isodrive SE motor provides up to 3200m³/hr airflow when correctly installed, giving you strong extraction for everyday cooking and larger meals. Five speed levels let you choose a lower setting for simmering or more airflow for heavier cooking. The 15-minute auto shut-off timer keeps this running after you’ve finished, helping clear remaining vapours while you move on to serving and cleaning.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make it easy to select a fan speed or switch on the LED lighting while you’re cooking. The stainless steel black mesh filters capture grease during use and can go in the dishwasher, so filter maintenance doesn’t have to mean hand-washing after every meal. This ducted model doesn’t include a recirculation option.

Schweigen SteelFlex™ is included, supporting installation with the external motor system. This rangehood measures 1180mm wide, 295mm deep and 285mm high, and weighs 12kg. It includes a 10-year motor warranty, five-year canopy warranty, lifetime filter warranty and lifetime GU10 LED globe warranty. Picture a wide cooktop handling dinner while this stays tucked into the cabinetry above.

copy.npr_heading: Schweigen Silent Inline Motor Undermount Rangehood 120cm – Black Steel
copy.npr_short_copy: Cooking several dishes at once can leave a large cooktop feeling smoky and cluttered. This 120cm ducted rangehood keeps extraction discreet in 300mm-deep cabinetry, with five speeds, LED lighting, soft-touch controls and dishwasher-safe mesh filters for easier cooking and clean-up.
copy.npr_long_copy:
Large meals can quickly fill a kitchen with cooking vapours, especially when several burners are working at once. This 120cm ducted undermount rangehood keeps extraction out of sight in 300mm-deep cabinetry, making it a neat fit for modern kitchens with a large cooktop or island bench.

The Isodrive® SPINL motor system provides powerful, quiet extraction when properly ducted and installed, while five speed levels let you match airflow to simmering, everyday cooking or heavier frying. When dinner's finished, the 15-minute auto shut-off timer keeps this running while remaining vapours clear, then switches it off without another trip to the controls.

Soft-touch controls and a digital display make it easy to select a setting while you're cooking. LED lighting helps illuminate the cooktop, and the black mesh filters are dishwasher-safe, so regular cleaning doesn't need to become a separate kitchen job. This rangehood is ducted only and doesn't include a recirculation option.

The Black Steel finish adds a dark, understated look beneath overhead joinery, while the included Schweigen SteelFlex™ supports the ducted installation. Warranty coverage includes 10 years for the motor, five years for the canopy, and lifetime coverage for the filters and GU10 LED globe. It's made for busy home cooks who want a broad extraction zone that stays discreet during a weekend dinner with several pans on the go. Silent refers to the rangehood system, although air movement may be heard at higher speeds.
